AlreadyElided: envelope was elided, so it cannot be compressed or encrypted
AmbiguousPredicate: more than one assertion matches the predicate
MissingDigest: a digest was expected but not found
NotWrapped: cannot unwrap an envelope that was not wrapped
NotLeaf: the envelope's subject is not a leaf
NotAssertion: the envelope's subject is not an assertion
InvalidAssertion: assertion must be a map with exactly one element
NotCompressed: cannot decompress an envelope that was not compressed
AlreadyEncrypted: envelope was already encrypted or compressed, so it cannot be encrypted
NotEncrypted: cannot decrypt an envelope that was not encrypted
NotKnownValue: the envelope's subject is not a known value
UnverifiedInnerSignature: inner signature not made with same key as outer signature
SubjectNotUnit: the subject of the envelope is not the unit value
